Class of Agent in Treatment Arm 1.note: Page 1 abstract prints 'Orteronel (TAK-700) is a nonsteroidal 17,20-lyase inhibitor' (the introduction also calls it 'a novel CYP17 inhibitor' that inhibits CYP17, 20 lyase), and orteronel is the only agent added to ADT in the experimental arm, so '17,20-lyase inhibitor (Orteronel)' is correct.
